label: Bible Study
prompt: The _____ of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
verse: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
note: Nothing slips past heaven's notice — the evil and the good alike.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal _____.
verse: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
note: The promise in one phrase: eternal life — and the One who promised it keeps His word.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was _____ cubits and a span.
verse: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
note: Goliath stood six cubits and a span tall — over nine feet by the usual reckoning.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Henceforth there is laid up for me a _____ of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verse: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
note: Paul's last letter, with his 'departure' at hand: the crown isn't for him only, but all who love his appearing.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are _____ wolves.
verse: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
note: False prophets in sheep's clothing, 'inwardly ravening wolves' — the original wolf in sheep's clothing.
